raw.hi: 8. सिरका में निम्न में कौन-सा अम्ल पाया जाता है ? raw.en: 8. Which of the following acids is found in vinegar ? (A) Acetic acid (B) Sulphuric acid (C) Formic acid (D) Hydrochloric acid | 9. The absolute refractive index of air is actually (A) less than 1 (B) more than 1 (C) equal to 1 (D) 0 | 10. Mirror used by ENT (Ear-Nose-throat) doctor is (A) convex mirror (B) concave mirror (C) plane mirror (D) none of these

notes: Q8 (Chemistry, last of the Chemistry-first block Q1-8), then Q9-10 start Physics. Answer key: Q8=(A) Acetic acid, Q9=(B) more than 1, Q10=(B) concave mirror. Faint pen mark visible near Q9 option (B) 'more than 1' — matches printed-correct answer, but per F3 not treated as answer source.
